name: Shops at Arrive West End
summary: Shops at Arrive West End is a contemporary lifestyle center in Dallas's historic West End district, offering a modern mixed-use retail experience at 800 Ross Avenue. Part of the larger Arrive West End development, it combines shopping convenience with urban living in one of downtown Dallas's most vibrant neighborhoods.
demographics: Shops at Arrive West End attracts a diverse urban demographic in the Dallas West End Historic District, drawing young professionals and downtown residents with median household incomes ranging from middle to upper-middle class. The trade area serves a mix of urban dwellers, office workers from nearby downtown Dallas, and tourists visiting the historic West End entertainment district. Primary visitors include millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-45 who value walkable, mixed-use environments with convenient access to retail, dining, and residential amenities in an urban setting.
description: Shops at Arrive West End is a modern lifestyle destination located in the heart of Dallas's historic West End district at 800 Ross Avenue. This contemporary mixed-use development seamlessly blends retail shopping with residential living, creating a vibrant urban community in one of Dallas's most storied neighborhoods. The center is part of the larger Arrive West End development, which has revitalized this historic area with a fresh approach to urban living and shopping. Currently offering special leasing incentives including one month free rent, the property features a curated selection of retail tenants designed to serve the needs of both residents and visitors to the West End district. With its prime location near downtown Dallas and excellent walkability, Shops at Arrive West End represents a new generation of urban retail that prioritizes convenience, community, and contemporary design in a neighborhood rich with Dallas history and culture.
